Karma is a daily invitation to rest. One painting. One guided meditation. Five minutes to give yourself a little care.

A new five-minute practice is created every morning in Derek and Sarah voices. Topics draw from Eastern philosophy for achievers and seekers. Revisit the meditation as often as you like.
